While the study heavily emphasizes glycosylation, the MS part was a global protein identification ('gel-free nano-LC-MS/MS'). The glycosylation analysis was performed primarily via lectin blotting and flow cytometry, not via MS-based glycopeptide enrichment. However, the study's goal was to characterize the glycoproteome, and N-terminal acetylation was searched as a variable modification.
